_plain_doc: plain_names: a name as it came, and as both apps show and judge it (src/net/file_risk.rs plain_name, web/shared/file-risk.js plainName): direction marks taken out (a right-to-left override shows photo<RLO>gnp.exe as photoexe.png), other control characters made spaces, trimmed.
_doc: Cases both apps' file checks must agree on (data/safety/file_risks.json; src/net/file_risk.rs tests and scripts/tests/file-risk-web.test.js). `head` is the file's first bytes in hex (empty: not known). `kind` null: no word of caution. `words`, when given, is the exact text. `type` and `level` are the file's badge (file_type / fileType): every file has one.

cases.name: setup.exe
cases.words: This is a program (.exe). A program can do anything on your computer, like stealing your passwords or locking your files until you pay. Only open it if you trust the person who sent it, and check it with your antivirus first.

cases.head: 1f8b0800
cases.words: This is an archive (.tar.gz): a package holding other files. Nothing inside it has been checked. Check it with your antivirus before you open what it holds, and take care with any program inside.

cases.head: 424c454e444552
cases.words: Blender files can carry scripts: small programs that run inside Blender and can harm your computer. If Blender asks whether to run them, say no unless you trust the person who shared it.
